concerns.text: T005 instructs raising a 'fatal error' if data exceeds RAM. This contradicts Spec FR-005 and Plan 'Memory Safety Constraint' which mandate graceful degradation to OLS-only. No task exists to implement the required fallback logic (degrade to OLS, log 'OLS_DEGRADED') when memory limits are breached.

T034 requires 'fail loudly' if GWR_BANDWIDTHS is missing. Spec FR-005/Plan require graceful degradation to OLS if resource-intensive configs cannot be met. No task covers the fallback path for missing bandwidth config.

T032a requires 'fatal error' if literature_bounds.json is missing. Spec FR-010 requires calculating the 'Unexplained Variance Gap'. No task exists to handle the missing file case (e.g., skip gap calculation, log limitation) without crashing the pipeline.

T026c describes degradation logic but lacks explicit instruction to log 'model_type: OLS_DEGRADED' to metrics.csv and stdout as required by Spec FR-005. This creates a gap in traceability for the fallback event.

T033 defines metrics.csv schema but omits the 'sampling_applied' boolean flag required by Plan (T026a/b/c) to distinguish full vs. sampled data runs, violating SC-001/SC-003 traceability for memory constraint events.
T001 creates 'docs/' directory, but Spec/Plan Project Structure only defines 'data/results/' for reports. This creates a structural inconsistency not authorized by design artifacts.
